{{Current events|year=2019|month=03|day=11|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Battle of Baghuz Fawqani]], [[International military intervention against ISIL]]
**[[Syrian Democratic Forces#Support by the United States, France and other Western nations|US-backed Syrian forces]] resume their offensive on the final enclave controlled by [[ISIL]] in [[Syria]] at [[Al-Baghuz Fawqani|Baghuz]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-islamic-state/islamic-state-enclave-pounded-in-u-s-backed-assault-idUSKBN1QS1I3?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/backed-syrian-forces-resume-attacks-final-isil-enclave-190310180555338.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Business and economy
*[[Economy of Turkey]]
**The [[Turkey|Turkish]] economy enters a [[recession]] for the first time since 2009 after the [[Turkish currency and debt crisis, 2018|currency and debt crisis]] of 2018. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-47522338 (BBC)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-03-10/debt-catches-up-with-turkey-as-recession-ends-boom-and-bust-run (Bloomberg)]
*The [[United Kingdom]] announces it will abolish the [[Financial Reporting Council]], which regulates the nation's accounting industry, after it was criticised by an independent review following the collapse of several large organisations. It is to be replaced by the [[Audit, Reporting and Governance Authority]] featuring increased powers and new leaders. [https://news.sky.com/story/accounting-regulator-to-be-scrapped-after-damning-review-11662454 (Sky News)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302]]
**Shares of [[Boeing]] lose roughly 9 percent after one of its best-selling planes, the [[Boeing 737 MAX]] jet, saw its second deadly crash in less than five months. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/11/boeing-shares-sink-after-fatal-crashthree-experts-weigh-in.html (CNBC)]
**[[China]] and [[Indonesia]] ground 737-8 MAX aircraft across their nations in response to the Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 and [[Lion Air Flight 610]] disasters; airlines elsewhere including [[Ethiopian Airlines]] voluntarily ground their own 737 MAX jets. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/ethiopia-plane-crash-china-boeing-a8817271.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[HMS Argyll (F231)|HMS ''Argyll'']] rescues a 27-strong crew from a burning container vessel 150 miles off the coast of [[France]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/uk-england-devon-47527837/royal-navy-save-crew-from-burning-container-ship (BBC)]
;International relations
*[[Iran–Iraq relations]]
**[[Iranian President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] begins his first official visit to Iraq to boost bilateral ties and trade amid re-instated [[United States sanctions against Iran#Post-JCPOA sanctions|U.S. sanctions on Iran]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47524688 (BBC)]
*[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Lindsey Graham]] visits the [[Israel|Israeli]]-occupied [[Golan Heights]], saying he will start an effort to recognize the Golan as part of the State of Israel. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-march-11-2019/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
;Law and crime
*[[Mixed martial arts|Mixed martial artist]] [[Conor McGregor]] is arrested in [[Miami Beach, Florida|Miami Beach]], [[Florida]], on charges of robbery and criminal mischief. [https://www.lowkickmma.com/breaking-conor-mcgregor-arrested-on-robbery-charges-in-miami/ (LowKick MMA)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**[[2019 Venezuelan blackout]]
***Partially-recognized [[Venezuela]]n Acting President [[Juan Guaidó]] says the country has "truly collapsed already", while accusing the [[Nicolás Maduro]]-led government of murdering 17 people during the ongoing nationwide [[Power outage|power blackout]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/03/11/americas/venezuela-guaido-maduro-blackout/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Algerian protests]]
**[[Algerian President]] [[Abdelaziz Bouteflika]] says he will postpone the country's [[2019 Algerian presidential election|elections]] next month, and will not seek a fifth term in office. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/algeria-bouteflika-delays-elections-seek-term-190311174206302.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Prime Minister of Algeria]] [[Ahmed Ouyahia]] resigns after Bouteflika's speech. He is replaced by Noureddine Bedoui. [https://www.jeuneafrique.com/747782/politique/algerie-le-premier-ministre-ahmed-ouyahia-demissionne-noureddine-bedoui-le-remplace/ (Jeune Afrique)]
*Actor and former [[Ministry of Culture (Peru)|Minister of Culture]] [[Salvador del Solar]] is appointed new [[Prime Minister of Peru]]. [https://elpais.com/internacional/2019/03/11/america/1552333282_057898.html (''El País'')]
